posts.author: Kris Meerlo
posts.content_md:
Hi Eric,

It is a little bit difficult to explain for me in English.

It has nothing to do with kind of plate you using.

But when you turn the hologram slowly in the light the hologram playback in different colors when I make a hologram not at brewster angle then

the holograms color at eye hight is different then a hologram made at another angle at eye hight ( when you hang it on the wall in your house ).
